_comment: Chapter E validation cases with an INDEPENDENT PUBLISHED source.
Provenance of what is here: AISC Manual Table 4-1a values recorded in the
aisc-steel-design skill's validate.py
(D:/Download/AI estimation/Design/aisc-steel-design/), which cites Table 4-1a
directly. These are Manual column-load-table values, NOT AISC Design Examples
V16.0 cases -- that companion is still not on this machine, so no case here
claims to be E.1A-E.7.
Each case:
id        label for the test report
source    where the expected value came from -- required, no exceptions
section   canonical property names (Ag, rx, ry, Ix, Iy, J, Cw), US customary
grade     any designation pyaisc360.materials.grade() accepts
Lcx, Lcy  effective lengths in INCHES (the Manual prints feet)
Lcz       optional, defaults to Lcy
symmetry  'doubly symmetric' | 'singly symmetric about the y-axis'
| 'singly symmetric about the x-axis' | 'unsymmetric'
basis     'LRFD' or 'ASD'
expected  phi_c*Pn (LRFD) or Pn/Omega_c (ASD), in KIPS
tol       optional relative tolerance, default 0.005 (3 significant figures)
skip      optional true to park a case without deleting it

cases.note: Manual prints 1030 kips; 3 significant figures of the exact 1025.6.

cases.source: AISC Manual Table 4-1a upper bound = phi_c*Fy*Ag = 0.90*50*26.5
cases.note: Both flexural and torsional buckling cap at Fy as Lc -> 0.
